minimum_quality_requirements: Preserve the original requester language verbatim.
Apply the canonical generation request automatically.
Populate every canonical metadata field in exact order.
Mirror front matter in the canonical Record metadata table.
Include an explicit TOC and every mandatory section in order.
Keep Five Ws and How consistent with canonical metadata.
Create atomic claims and trace each claim to evidence IDs.
Separate expected results, observations, and derived conclusions.
Preserve failed paths separately from the accepted final state.
Document rationale, alternatives, tradeoffs, and consequences.
Document security, rollback, rebuild, operations, and revalidation.
Identify limitations, assumptions, evidence gaps, and confidence.
Store artifacts under the permanent evidence ID and hash each file.
Produce one package that passes the repository publisher check.
Return only the package and standard check and publish commands.
